observations.footwork: Fighter shuffles forward, closing distance to pad holder
observations.guard: Both hands held high, protecting face
observations.upper_body: Slight forward lean, preparing to attack
observations.distance: Closing range, moving from out of range to punching range
observations.notable: Fighter is moving into position to throw a punch

observations.footwork: Weight transfers to lead foot, slight forward step
observations.guard: Rear hand extends forward, lead hand stays high
observations.upper_body: Torso rotates, rear hand throws straight punch
observations.notable: Straight right cross thrown at full extension

observations.footwork: Fighter settles back into stance, no major movement
observations.guard: Hands return to high guard position
observations.upper_body: Torso rotates back to neutral position
observations.notable: Recovery from punch and reset for next action

movement_events.detail: Fighter shuffles forward to close the gap toward pad holder
Rear hand throws a straight cross, extended toward the focus mitt
Punch retracted, hand pulled back toward guard
Fighter returns to stance, regains high guard, prepares for next exchange
